steps.name: p5e-1-baker-plan
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; export PATH=/home/greg/.local/share/nodeenv-gorb/bin:$PATH; R=$PWD; test -z "$(git diff --name-only 0303a6be -- apps/clock/main.c main apps/clock/version.txt)" && cd $R/apps/clock/editor/_selftest && node headless-subdial.test.js | tail -1 | grep -q 'all green' && for f in headless-*.test.js; do [ $f = headless-sound.test.js ] && continue; node $f > /tmp/suite.log 2>&1 || { echo FAIL $f; tail -20 /tmp/suite.log; exit 1; }; GORB_HOST='{"kind":"hub"}' NODE_OPTIONS="--require=$R/tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/gorb-host-preload.js" node $f > /tmp/suite.log 2>&1 || { echo FAIL hub $f; tail -20 /tmp/suite.log; exit 1; }; echo ok $f; done && cd $R && ! grep -rIn 'does not close under its own hand\|hosts another indication\|COMP3_RING_FULL\|pointerPlan3\|pointerDefault3' apps tools
